data.name: Shivnandan
data.gender_notes: Shivnandan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Shivnandan is a compound name, Shiv meaning God and Nandan meaning pleasure or delight. The name Shivnandan signifies the God of Gods, the one who delights in the divine. This name is a source of immense spiritual power and strength. The name Shivnandan carries the meaning “God of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shivnandan usually hope their child will grow to embody god of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes the presence of Lord Shiva, the Supreme God, in one's life. It represents devotion, faith, and a deep connection to the divine.
data.etymology: Shivnandan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shivnandan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shivnandan holds immense cultural significance in the Hindu tradition. Lord Shiva is regarded as the supreme God and the embodiment of the absolute reality, representing the destruction and creation of the universe. Shivnandan is a devotional title that celebrates this deity's role in our lives. Shiva is the giver of blessings and wisdom, and the name Shivnandan acknowledges this divine relationship. It is an expression of deep reverence and love for the one who delights us with his divine grace.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Shivnandan signifies a spiritual connection to the divine. It is a reminder of the ultimate truth that the source of all pleasure, all joy, and all delight is the divine. Shiva, as the supreme God, is the one who bestows this joy and delight upon us. By carrying this name, one is reminded of the importance of maintaining a constant connection to the divine and seeking divine guidance and blessings in all aspects of life. It is a declaration of one's dedication to the Divine Shiva and a commitment to live a life in devotion to the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shivnandan: God Shiva's graceful and compassionate embodiment. The name signifies one who carries the blessings of Lord Shiva within, spreading love, peace, and wisdom.
